create_AiderCoder: create an AiderCoder instance with a specific model name and configuration options
run_AiderCoder_code: run the AiderCoder code method to generate code for a task with file targets
get_aider_model_name: get the Aider-compatible model name from a standard model name string
set_env_vars_for_model: set environment variables for Azure, Gemini, or OpenAI model API access
configure_AiderCoder_edit_format: configure the AiderCoder to use diff format with strict diff enforcement
